brief:
Spain's High Court released pro-Palestinian donor and US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr. on bail, according to Middle East Eye. Chambers, whose family owns media interests in the United States, faced legal proceedings related to his pro-Palestine activism and financial support for related causes.

Details of the charges and bail conditions were not immediately specified. The release followed his detention in Spain, where the High Court had been examining the case.

title: Spain frees US media heir Chambers on bail in pro-Palestine case
